# Serenity UI — Comprehensive Component & Block Catalog

> Serenity UI (https://serenity-ui.com) is an open-source React, Tailwind CSS, Canvas, and Framer Motion library created by Ayushmaan Singh (@ayushmxxn). Released under the MIT License.

## Full Catalog

### 1. Portfolio Book
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Interactive / 3D
- **Description**: Interactive flippable sketch portfolio book component for React and Tailwind CSS featuring realistic page-turning physics, handwritten typography, and sound effects.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/portfolio-book
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/portfolio-book`
- **Dependencies**: none

### 2. Vintage Keyboard
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Interactive / Retro
- **Description**: Retro mechanical typewriter and keyboard interactive simulator for React with synthesized mechanical key sounds, tactile keypress states, and Tailwind CSS.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/vintage-keyboard
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/vintage-keyboard`
- **Dependencies**: none (uses Web Audio API)

### 3. Flame Button
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Buttons & CTAs
- **Description**: Organic flame and particle fire button component for React featuring GPU-accelerated canvas shaders, dynamic hover physics, and customizable glow.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/flame-button
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/flame-button`
- **Dependencies**: none (HTML5 Canvas)

### 4. 3D Flip Card
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Cards
- **Description**: 3D perspective hover flip card component for React with smooth spring-animated rotational tilt, dual-sided content reveal, and Tailwind CSS transforms.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/flip-card-3d
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/flip-card-3d`
- **Dependencies**: `framer-motion`

### 5. Brand Marquee
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Social Proof
- **Description**: High-performance continuous logo marquee component for React with smooth edge-fade gradient masks, pause on hover, and dark mode support.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/brand-marquee
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/brand-marquee`
- **Dependencies**: `lucide-react`

### 6. Swipe Card
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Interactive
- **Description**: Interactive gesture-based swipeable stack card component for React with physics-driven drag velocity, auto-rotation, and touch gesture support.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/swipe-card
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/swipe-card`
- **Dependencies**: `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`

### 7. 3D Image Carousel
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Media & Galleries
- **Description**: Smooth 3D rotational perspective image carousel component for React with interactive dragging, depth scaling, and responsive layout.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/image-carousel
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/image-carousel`
- **Dependencies**: `framer-motion`

### 8. Image Gallery
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Media & Galleries
- **Description**: Modern masonry photo gallery component for React with fluid expand-to-fullscreen layout animations and high-resolution lightbox preview.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/image-gallery
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/image-gallery`
- **Dependencies**: `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`

### 9. Tubelight Navbar
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Navigation
- **Description**: Apple-inspired floating tubelight navigation bar for React with smooth spring-physics glowing indicator, audio feedback, and dark mode.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/tubelight-navbar
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/tubelight-navbar`
- **Dependencies**: `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`

### 10. Typewriter Testimonial
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Social Proof
- **Description**: Animated typewriter customer testimonial quote card for React with realistic typing cadence, avatar badge, and author verification.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/typewriter-testimonial
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/typewriter-testimonial`
- **Dependencies**: `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`

### 11. Carousel 360
- **Type**: Component
- **Category**: Interactive / 3D
- **Description**: 360-degree cylinder 3D carousel component for React with spatial depth perspective, continuous rotational dragging, and interactive item inspection.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/components/carousel-360
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/carousel-360`
- **Dependencies**: none (CSS 3D transforms)

### 12. Voice Testimonial
- **Type**: Block & Component
- **Category**: Social Proof / Blocks
- **Description**: Audio voice note testimonial section block for React featuring interactive audio waveforms, play/pause controls, duration counters, and verified creator badges.
- **URL**: https://serenity-ui.com/blocks/testimonial
- **Install**: `npx shadcn@latest add ayushmxxn/serenity-ui/testimonial`
- **Dependencies**: `lucide-react`, `framer-motion`
